label: ercot81 nonreleasable as
definition: ercot81 nonreleasable-AS: the ercot80 keeper recipe + ercot_nonreleasable_as_withholding — the published pre-RTC+B RRS/Reg-Up HASL carve-out (no price-based SCED release until RTC+B go-live 2025-12-05; the 2024-08-01 release reform was ECRS-only) priced as rigid at-cap reserve demand, so tight-hour energy duals climb the offer surface instead of shedding withheld reserve down an RTC+B-era ramp the 2023-2025 market did not have.
